cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Say You’re Sorry
cards.instruction: Maneuver someone into apologizing without naming the offense.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your parents arrive in ten minutes. I'll get us smiling before they ring; we only need to finish one small conversation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought we'd finished it by text.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The thumbs-up was a useful start. Give me the words that go with it and I'll call us ready.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can send a sad face if that helps.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It does. Keep the phone down and give me that face with a sentence starting 'I'm sorry.' Quietly is fine; I just need to hear it before I open the door.
